events.title: Demo Update: Controller Support, Improvements & Release Date Update
events.summary: This update focuses on feedback and issues found during recent playtesting.Added Controller Support No Visitors Allowed can now be played using a controller, including menu and settings navigation.Added Arrow Key Movement Players can now use the arrow keys as an alternative to WASD. During playtesting, I noticed this was important for some left-handed players and players with accessibility needs.Improved Tutorial Guidance The tutorial prompt will now appear again whenever the player returns to H

events.title: Demo Update: Steam Achievements, New Anomaly & Improvements
events.summary: A new update for the No Visitors Allowed Demo is now live.This build adds Steam Achievements, including several hidden achievements and easter eggs for players who like to explore and experiment with the hallway.I have also added a new anomaly, improved the system that determines which anomalies appear, and made several visual and performance improvements throughout the demo. events.title: No Visitors Allowed Featured on IGN!
events.summary: We are incredibly excited to share that No Visitors Allowed has been featured on IGN’s main YouTube channel!As a solo developer working on my first game, seeing No Visitors Allowed on IGN is a milestone I never imagined reaching.A huge thank you to everyone who has played the demo, wishlisted the game, shared feedback, or supported the project so far. Your support means a lot and continues to help shape the game.🎬 Watch the trailer on IGN: The No Visitors Allowed Demo is available now on Steam,

events.title: No Visitors Allowed First Public Playtest Has Ended
events.summary: Hi Everyone, The first public playtest for No Visitors Allowed has now ended.Thank you so much to everyone who played, shared feedback, or reported issues. I will now go through everything and work on improvements ahead of the demo.This was only the first playtest, so more updates are coming.Thank you again.
